Became an enterprise-ready developer in six months as part of the CODA 13 cohort. Graduated into TDP after completing my Dojo project in Cyber Intel building a MERN stack feature for a security remediation platform. Spent my first rotation in Cyber IAM wearing many hats (frontend, design, infrastructure, etc.) maintaining custom authorization plugins, and ended up finishing the program in Cyber D&M as a full stack engineer for our self-service platform.

Including: PMBF Program, UNA-Orlando, BallotReady, The COVID-19 Tracking Project, Council on Foreign Relations, the Hub Project, Swing Left, New America, ActBlue, KRC Research, and ActBlue Technical Services.
Called low-propensity voters, handwrote outreach letters, and tried my best to get Democratic candidates down the ballot elected across Florida, Georgia, and Texas.
